title: Meeting Summary
discussion_points: Sarah's team finished wireframes for the new onboard flow, but design feedback requires revisions, estimated to take 3-4 days.
Anas's team can start backend development for the onboard flow in parallel, estimating one week for API endpoints and database schema extension.
Omar proposed an AI meeting intelligence agent to automate meeting minute generation and push action items to Planner.
Omar needs access to Azure speech API and SharePoint templates to develop the AI proof of concept.
Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday, requiring department estimates by Friday.
decisions: Proceed with revisions for the new onboard flow wireframes.
Start backend development for the new onboard flow in parallel with design revisions.
Prioritize the development of an AI meeting intelligence agent.
Provision Azure resources for Omar by tomorrow.
Grant Omar access to SharePoint templates library.
All department estimates for Q3 budget review must be submitted by Friday.
